account: On 28 October 2022 North Rhine-Westphalia's (NRW) Interior Ministry said DAR, the police's Palantir software, was central in several recent cases (WELT; RP Online). In October someone had emailed the Siegen city administration announcing an amok attack. The threat was over the city's “topless” permission for swimming pools. The ministry said the email address revealed the suspect via Palantir in fractions of a second. A shooting in Duisburg-Hamborn between a Turkish-Arab clan and the Hells Angels injured four people. A Duisburg investigator said police quickly identified 51 of the roughly 100 participants, about 20 minutes each (RP Online; WELT). 49 of them were assigned to rival groups. Interior Minister Herbert Reul addressed the Landtag's interior committee on 27 October. He said DAR links the weapons register, residents' registration, the police case system and the wanted-persons portal. The ministry puts the 2019–2025 cost at about 39 million euros. The opposition attacks it on data-protection and cost grounds (WELT).

ai_role.statement: The reports describe DAR as software that links entries across the weapons register, residents' registration data, the police case system and the wanted-persons portal. None mentions machine learning. The minister himself describes plain linking, while the OECD AI Incidents Monitor calls it an AI system. On the ministry's account the software's contribution was speed of identification. That was an email address in fractions of a second and about 20 minutes per shooting participant. Whether manual queries would have reached the same people more slowly is not addressed. The claims come from the deploying ministry and an unnamed investigator.

fields.account: On 28 October 2022 North Rhine-Westphalia's (NRW) Interior Ministry said DAR, the police's Palantir software, was central in several recent cases (WELT; RP Online). In October someone had emailed the Siegen city administration announcing an amok attack. The threat was over the city's “topless” permission for swimming pools. The ministry said the email address revealed the suspect via Palantir in fractions of a second. A shooting in Duisburg-Hamborn between a Turkish-Arab clan and the Hells Angels injured four people. A Duisburg investigator said police quickly identified 51 of the roughly 100 participants, about 20 minutes each (RP Online; WELT). 49 of them were assigned to rival groups. Interior Minister Herbert Reul addressed the Landtag's interior committee on 27 October. He said DAR links the weapons register, residents' registration, the police case system and the wanted-persons portal. The ministry puts the 2019–2025 cost at about 39 million euros. The opposition attacks it on data-protection and cost grounds (WELT).

They identified 51 of about 100 shooting participants at about 20 minutes each, per the ministry and a Duisburg investigator. No comparison with conventional methods and no charges or convictions are reported.

Siegen's administration and public had the author of a threatened amok attack identified. The sources do not say whether the threat was credible, whether the person was charged, or what harm was averted.

echoes.setting: August 2022, North Rhine-Westphalia: per the ministry, DAR led from one burglar to a whole gang
August 2022, North Rhine-Westphalia: DAR identified a man suspected of abusing a 13-year-old girl from only a nickname and a phone number with fake owner data

must_hold: The person already appears in one of the linked databases. The system links records and does not generate new ones
Investigators have lawful access to the linked registers. The opposition contests the arrangement on data-protection grounds
Licensing continues. The ministry puts the 2019–2025 cost at about 39 million euros
produced_by: Police and administrative databases (weapons register, residents' registration, case-processing system, wanted-persons portal) linked in one Palantir-based search
An identifier from the case, such as an email address, a nickname or a phone number, that matches an entry somewhere in the linked data

revisions.change: Record drafted from the OECD Monitor entry and the cited sources.
Benefit type set to Improved Knowledge Discovery under Trustible's full taxonomy of 23 types; it was Improved Organizational Efficiency among the six first used.
Country of the developer and the deployer added from the organization's own site or a registry.
Prose pass: a rating reason, account, purpose, the replication conditions, the system's part rewritten in shorter sentences with abbreviations expanded; facts, figures and quotations unchanged.

summary: NRW Interior Ministry, 28 Oct 2022: Palantir-based DAR resolved an amok-threat email against Siegen's city administration in seconds and identified 51 of about 100 people at a Duisburg clan shooting.
system: DAR (Datenbankübergreifende Recherche und Analyse), Palantir software used by North Rhine-Westphalia police
title: The Palantir-based DAR software identifies the author of an emailed amok threat against Siegen's city administration in fractions of a second and 51 of about 100 participants in a Duisburg shooting (28 October 2022)
